name: 332a-attr-list
description: An attrList tile (eink-ha-os#332): entity (sensor), attribute / title / time = field names, subtitle = up to 3 field names split by spaces, empty = free text, label; all but entity optional (defaults sightings, title, subtitle, ts; eink-ha-os#375).
input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: attrList, entity: sensor.rare_birds_nearby, cs: 2, rs: 2}
      - {type: attrList, entity: sensor.departures_board, attribute: trains, title: destination, subtitle: platform, time: departs, empty: No trains, label: Trains, cs: 2, rs: 2}
